title: Conditional Statements in Python
description: Master Python conditional statements: write if, elif, and else blocks, and build the complex decision-making logic your programs need.
summary: From the previous tutorials in this series, you now have quite a bit of Python code under your belt. Everything you have seen so far has consisted of sequential execution , in which statements are always performed one after the next, in exactly the order specified.
